requirements: Run a doctrine expertise completeness auditor before, during, and after work.
Prove deterministically that required audit executions occurred while not claiming deterministic proof of epistemic completeness.
Automatically select or compose appropriate task-local expert and research roles over time without routine human staffing.
Use deep source and qualification packs rather than thin expert labels.
Check every material citation, source quality, entailment, counterevidence, prompt-goal alignment, and authority boundary.
Classify doctrine traditions, ancient Jewish worlds, archaeology and external ancient contexts, philosophy, theologian corpora, and verification methods.
Keep non-Christian context outside canonical Scripture and normative Christian doctrine authority.
Attach risk reasons and expose high-risk disagreement to the named human.
Red-team and premortem the design, repair major findings, and freeze a Fable review packet.
